### What

The COM interface macros use the paste! procedural macro to concatenate identifiers during compilation. This generates names such as interface, consumer, and producer types, along with accessor names such as getters and setters. The crate supports macro-based API generation; it does not provide runtime COM behavior.

Acceptance criteria

- Record the pinned crate version, enabled features, and exact identifier-pasting patterns used.
- Review provenance, license, maintenance status, and safety relevance.
- Document whether to retain paste, use pastey as a replacement, or implement the limited required functionality internally.
- Record the required qualification artifacts and validate any replacement against the generated API.
